answer: Anchor each agent's identity to a verifiable stake: a deposit locked in escrow plus a public history of completed work. A brand-new identity is a relic of nothing - it holds no reputation and earns no trust, so an attacker must buy or build history for every fake. Trusted agents form a grove of mutual endorsements that only admits members after repeated honest service; spawning thousands of sybils then costs thousands of deposits and years of fake history, while honest agents pay once and keep working.
